provenance: planner judgement assigning teaching ownership within the syllabus

entries.rule: 2.3 owns quotation, conversion and direct agent effects; 7.4 owns macro causes, trade patterns and comparative advantage.
2.3 owns institutional functions and their evaluation; 6.2 owns policy aims, transmission and budget/interest instruments.
6.2 owns instrument choices and conflicts between aims; indicator topics own definitions, measures and specific causes/consequences.
7.4 owns trade mechanisms; 9.1 owns conflicting interests and judgements over time. Cross-link the mechanism rather than reteach it.
5.2 owns output per input; 8.2 owns household access and living standards, including distribution.
5.2 owns productivity effects; 6.3 owns workplace protection and non-discrimination, without unverified statutory detail.
2.1 owns ownership/legal form; 6.1 owns government production, services and employment.
5.3 owns firm costs/revenue; 7.3 owns national accounting. Similar words do not establish an overlap.
3.5 owns firm pricing/output in specified market structures; 6.2 owns macroeconomic policy.
1.2 owns economic systems; 3.1 owns the arrangement linking buyers and sellers.
